authority.jurisdiction: Canonical V3 developmental/generation phase identity, actor-local phase state, allowed phase-transition graph, transition-admission contract, effective-time/replay law, and the read-only phase interface exposed to ContextResolver and downstream V3 consumers.
not_owned: phase-boundary value generation from population/demographic defaults
hybrid scheduler precedence or slow-maintenance cadence
V2 phenomenology, expression, transcript or life-season semantics

phase_vocabulary.semantic: A generation subject exists for governed context/planning, but no V3 actor-activation/birth event has yet established an active actor causal history.
asserts_only: generation subject identity may be referenced
generation-context resolution may occur where separately lawful
does_not_assert: age, caregiver, family, class, sect, position, personality or biography

phase_vocabulary.semantic: The first active actor developmental epoch after governed actor activation. It is an execution/query gate, not an age band or a claim about psychological imprint, dependency or caregiver identity.
asserts_only: actor causal runtime is active in the first canonical developmental epoch

phase_vocabulary.semantic: A bounded intermediate developmental epoch available to rules that explicitly require a distinct transition window. The phase itself does not assert autonomy, adulthood, legal status, role occupancy or identity.
asserts_only: the actor has a governed V3 transition record into this epoch

phase_vocabulary.semantic: The open-ended later developmental epoch after a governed transition. It is not a completed-development or maturity state and has no terminal personality meaning.
asserts_only: the actor has a governed V3 transition record into the open-ended epoch

initial_transition.required_witness: governed V3 actor-activation/birth event from the later actor-initialization authority
initial_transition.owner_note: ADP-008 validates the phase edge; ADP-007 later owns actor initialization and does not receive an initialization rule from ADP-008.

later_transition_requirements: exact current actor phase matches from_phase_id
requested from/to edge is present in this authority version
a V3DevelopmentalPhaseBoundaryBinding is present, valid and hash-verifiable
the boundary temporal eligibility is satisfied at transition effective_time
at least one non-age V3-generated causal witness/fact explicitly authorized by the binding producer is present
all named boundary predicates are TRUE under their bound rule/version
no denial, ambiguity, forbidden epistemic input or integrity failure is present
a V3 developmental-phase transition event/record is committed at the same effective_time

boundary_binding_contract.note: ADP-008 defines binding semantics but invents no actor-specific boundary values. A downstream V3 authority may bind them only within its own jurisdiction and provenance.

transition_contract.same_time_collision: Exact duplicate transition records with the same authoritative identity and content hash may deduplicate. Two non-identical transition candidates at the same actor/effective_time are AMBIGUOUS_PHASE_TRANSITION and neither applies.

causal_authority_inputs: prior V3 developmental phase state/transition record
GENERATED_RUNTIME_FACT with exact V3 causal parentage
an external interaction only after it has become an admitted V3 causal event
versioned V3 rule/predicate receipts named by the PhaseBoundaryBinding
guard_or_context_only_inputs: chronological age or elapsed time, when explicitly named as a guard
ResolvedStructuralContext and SelectionRecord references, as non-actor-fact context only
DERIVED_RUNTIME_VIEW only as a deterministic guard if the producing rule explicitly permits it and underlying causal refs remain reachable
forbidden_as_transition_authority: structural prior or resolver selection by itself
legacy lifecycle slot or age-band label
rendered narrative, dialogue, transcript or persona material
wall clock, filesystem order, mutable latest pointer

age_may: appear as an explicit eligibility/guard input in another governed rule
be recorded on a transition receipt for audit and replay
age_may_not: select a phase by an implicit if-age-then-phase table
satisfy the required non-age boundary witness by itself
supply personality, maturity, legal status, autonomy, school/work/family position or biography
age_law.known_age_unknown_phase: phase remains unresolved/current from ledger; age does not repair it
age_law.unknown_age_known_phase: verified phase ledger remains authoritative; missing age is separately typed unknown

effective_time_law.interval_semantics: Each active phase occupies [effective_from, effective_to); a committed transition at T closes the old phase at T and opens the new phase at T.
effective_time_law.late_evidence: Late-arriving evidence or changed policy may not mutate an already committed phase ledger in place. A correction requires explicit replay/reconstruction under governed causal inputs; old hashes remain audit-visible.
effective_time_law.future_binding: A future PhaseBoundaryBinding is noncausal until its effective condition is satisfied and a transition record is committed.

resolver_interaction.value: active V3DP phase_id + authority_version + phase_state_hash, or a typed unresolved state
resolver_may: use a supplied verified phase as a predicate input where policy explicitly requires phase
return phase-conditioned candidates according to preserved producer/runtime authority
defer phase-required candidates when phase is unresolved
resolver_may_not: infer or advance phase from age
infer phase from geography, structural priors, prevalence or demographic labels
resolver_interaction.unresolved_behavior: UNBOUND_REQUIRES_DEVELOPMENTAL_PHASE for objects/rules requiring phase; phase-independent resolution may continue.

genealogy_interaction.child_flow: A prospective child may exist as V3DP_GENERATION_PENDING; later ADP-007/ADP-015-governed generation and actor activation may establish the child's own foundational phase. Parent phase never defaults or transfers to the child.
forbidden: child existence or household role creation from phase
using phase as a substitute for genealogy/relationship/household state

decision_and_fail_closed_states.meaning: Verified current phase state exists and its history/hash chain is valid.
All edge, boundary, witness, predicate, effective-time and integrity conditions passed and a transition record was committed.
No lawful active phase can be established; phase-dependent consumers defer.
Current phase is known but no lawful next boundary binding exists; no auto-advance occurs.
Temporal eligibility may be satisfied but the required non-age generated witness is absent/unresolved.
Age/time crossed a consumer threshold but age is the only basis offered; transition does not occur.
Two non-identical same-time transition authorities/candidates survive; no semantic tie-break is invented.
Requested skip, reverse, same-phase or unknown edge is not in the canonical graph.
A source prior, demographic/identity label, V2 artifact, legacy age band or other forbidden input is offered as phase authority.
Missing/mismatched actor, version, hash, prior-state, predicate receipt or transition provenance prevents phase use.

required_replay_identity: boundary binding IDs/hashes and producer rule versions
named RNG provenance if any upstream witness-producing rule was stochastic
repository/resolver context receipts when referenced as context

authority_and_interface_consumers: age/development-gated V3 middle-state and orientation rules where they explicitly require phase

compatibility_constraints: Recovered yearly age/year fields remain chronology/cadence fields and may not become phase identity.
Legacy V2 driver-age stages and V2 current_life_phase seasons are not aliases for V3DP phase IDs.
No adapter may translate an age band to a V3DP phase without a governed PhaseBoundaryBinding and committed transition history.
A checkpoint imported at a later phase is valid only if the prior transition/hash chain is supplied and verified.
Phase vocabulary extensions require a new authority version and migration/replay rule; implementation code may not add ad hoc phase strings.

historical_source_evidence.authority_limit: Recovered V3/V2/server material is continuity/authority-recovery evidence only; archive V5/DDM material has zero authority over current V550+.

directly_inspected.finding: Explicit timestep=year and ordered causal/derived schedule.
directly_inspected.disposition: ADAPT_EVIDENCE_ONLY_FOR_PHASE: retain cadence/order continuity; year is not phase ontology.

directly_inspected.finding: Persistent actor state carries year/age and many longitudinal states but no canonical developmental-phase authority.
directly_inspected.disposition: PRESERVE_CHRONOLOGY_SEPARATION: age/year remain independent of phase.

directly_inspected.finding: run_one_year increments state.year and state.age; run_n_years advances by annual steps.
directly_inspected.disposition: ADAPT_AS_CADENCE_ONLY: not a phase transition law.

directly_inspected.finding: Life generation loops by age; LLM band runs every three years from age 5 plus anchor.
directly_inspected.disposition: EVIDENCE_ONLY: compute/render cadence is not phase identity.

directly_inspected.finding: Proxy striving uses discrete age brackets and nearest-bracket behavior.
directly_inspected.disposition: DO_NOT_CANONIZE: legacy age heuristic is not phase authority.

directly_inspected.finding: Wound sensitivities are seeded from identity and age.
directly_inspected.disposition: REJECT_AS_AUTHORITY: violates no structural/identity-prior -> developmental/psychic state shortcut.

directly_inspected.finding: Rupture injection uses hard-coded band ages and random probabilities.
directly_inspected.disposition: REJECT_AS_AUTHORITY: age band/random injection cannot define phase boundaries.

directly_inspected.finding: Age gates school/college proxies, practice/craft bonuses and field values; identity seeds wound/framework/crack state.
Phase 3 is an implementation milestone label; tests age-conditioned wound/channel activation.
current_life_phase is a present-life season such as job hunt, burnout or stable routine, derived for conversational modulation.
directly_inspected.disposition: V2_ONLY_NEGATIVE_EVIDENCE: never alias to V3 developmental phase.

directly_inspected.finding: Uses 0-7 imprint and later age bands while stating no type at birth.
directly_inspected.disposition: CONTINUITY_INTENT_ONLY: no-type-at-birth survives; age-band/type logic is not phase authority.

directly_inspected.finding: Legacy birth/school/adolescence/young-adult/adulthood driver slots with age cutoffs 0/6/12/18/30.
directly_inspected.disposition: REJECT_AS_CANONICAL_VOCABULARY: legacy lifecycle slots may not become ontology.

current_repo_evidence.finding: No canonical top-level v3/ source tree is present at this base; repository-root inspection exposes README.md, data/, section85/, and code searches for BackboneState/yearly_step.py/DevelopmentalEventLedger returned no current V3 implementation hits.
current_repo_evidence.use: There is no current V3 phase implementation to canonize; this W0 cell creates the missing authority only and does not modify code.

hostile_fixtures.case: Actor reaches a legacy age cutoff such as 18 with no lawful PhaseBoundaryBinding or non-age witness.
Known chronological age but missing/invalid phase ledger.
hostile_fixtures.required: PHASE_UNRESOLVED; age does not reconstruct phase.

hostile_fixtures.case: Structural prior/demographic category says adult/adolescent and is offered as transition authority.
V2 current_life_phase=burnout_phase is offered as V3 developmental phase.
Annual slow tick executes and age/year increment but no bound phase transition is due.
Phase boundary temporal eligibility is reached but required generated witness is unresolved.
Two non-identical same-time transition candidates remain valid.
Fresh generation attempts FOUNDATIONAL -> OPEN skip or OPEN -> FOUNDATIONAL regression.
Child is assigned a phase copied from a parent, household or demographic norm.
hostile_fixtures.required: BLOCKED_FORBIDDEN_PHASE_INFERENCE; child owns an independent phase ledger.

hostile_fixtures.case: Resolver Phase A/Phase B query purpose is passed as the developmental phase ID.
hostile_fixtures.required: BLOCKED_FORBIDDEN_PHASE_INFERENCE or schema validation failure; query purpose and phase are orthogonal.

hostile_fixtures.case: Later-phase checkpoint is loaded without prior transition hashes/receipts.
Late evidence proposes retroactive phase rewrite after committed later actor events.
hostile_fixtures.required: No in-place rewrite; require explicit replay/reconstruction with old history audit-visible.

hostile_fixtures.case: Illness/dependency change tries to reverse OPEN_DEVELOPMENT to an earlier phase.
hostile_fixtures.required: BLOCKED_INVALID_TRANSITION_EDGE; dependency/health is separate actor state.

hostile_fixtures.case: Historical archive V5/DDM lifecycle or age surface is offered as current phase authority.
hostile_fixtures.required: BLOCKED_FORBIDDEN_PHASE_INFERENCE; archive V5/DDM has zero authority.

hostile_fixtures.case: Exact duplicate transition record appears twice with same authoritative ID/hash.
hostile_fixtures.required: Safe deduplication; no second causal transition.

hostile_fixtures.case: A phase-required runtime rule executes while phase is unresolved.
hostile_fixtures.required: Rule defers/blocks according to its contract; no phase default.

consumer_release_sufficiency.meaning: MUST-008 itself is closed sufficiently for its named consumers: stable phase IDs, graph, boundary/transition contract, age law, resolver/genealogy/scheduler interfaces, fail-closed behavior and replay are defined. This does not globally release any V3 packet; each consumer remains gated by its other RA-R00 MUST/CAN/EXT dependencies.
